.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (byte comparison of tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/tools/*, tests/scoring.toml, environment/Dockerfile against the task)
Pattern scans over all 43 task files: credential shapes, PEM blocks, host paths, e-mail addresses, URLs, fetch commands, injection phrasing, zero-width/bidi/tag characters
evidence: Scanned all 43 files of the frozen task. (1) Credentials: the only credential-shaped values are task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a ${VAR} template) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`; this is the frozen shared verifier block the profile expects. No provider key shapes (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox, AIza, JWT) or PEM blocks anywhere, including the built bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js. Every other `token` hit is a syntax-highlighting token or the per-run crypto.randomUUID() postMessage nonce (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:384). No .env, .npmrc, key, database or log file is shipped; the only dotfile is tests/.dockerignore. (2) Personal data: environment/assets/seed_data.json is `{"snippets": [], "note": ...}` with no people or organisations; the only e-mail address is the template's reserved-TLD git identity environment/Dockerfile:20 `turing@local.invalid`; no personal names in the brief, instructions or app_context. The product has no accounts or sign-in. (3) Host paths: no drive-letter, /Users, /home, workspace or username strings in any task file; only container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests). (4) Remote fetch: solution/solve.sh:1-39 performs no network access (it checks the database is not open, removes it, then `cp -a` the prebuilt app). environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template; their npm and pip installs are version-pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7). package.json pins exact versions with no ranges; package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) has 178 resolved entries, all on https://registry.npmjs.org and all with integrity hashes. The served HTML loads only same-origin /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css; no CDN, no @import or url() in the CSS; server.js:16 sets a CSP of default-src 'self' with connect-src 'self'. URLs inside the bundle are XML namespaces and library documentation links in error strings (react.dev, prettier.io, w3.org, wikipedia, bugzilla), not fetches. (5) Injection: no instruction-override or grader-directed phrasing in the seed, brief, instructions, app_context, prompts or judge.toml files. Zero-width characters occur only in the bundle, in acorn's identifier-character tables (index.js:12027, 20563) and the HTML entity table (index.js:33240-33241). The seed `note` is a benign product description. Residual observations that are not defects under this row: base images are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned and apt packages are unversioned (environment/Dockerfile:1,5; tests/Dockerfile:1-2,12), which is template-controlled and byte-equal to the template, and the profile states build-time fetching on the public network is not a defect; server.js:142 binds 0.0.0.0, which is required for the verifier to reach the app. This is a static source review; no runtime measurement is required for this row and none is claimed.
